maintenance_led.reason: Mostly sells new pumps and pump systems to municipal, industrial, construction and OEM buyers; aftermarket is a smaller share.

publicly_funded.reason: Sells pumps via distributors to industrial, construction, agriculture, fire and OEM customers; municipal and military are only part.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by designing and selling its own pump lines; subsidiaries like Fill-Rite and AMT were occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Engineered pumps for flood control, wastewater, fire suppression and OEM products are specified in; switching needs requalification and risks downtime.

notes: Revenue split between new equipment and aftermarket, and the government share, are not stated in the text.
